items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I went to Chicago for three weeks with Phineas Newborn.

ctx.x: When you were out on the road, let’s see this would have been the 50s?
I went out with Nellie in January of ’58 for four months and then let’s see, I guess Christmas of ’58, the Christmas holidays, three weeks, I went to Chicago for three weeks with Phineas Newborn.
What were the accommodations like at that time?
